Independent proof review or Lean formalization is still required.

nodes.source_status: Editorial proof sketch awaiting independent replay; no new Lean build.
nodes.statement: In the admitted complex matrix model every column-stochastic kernel K has a CPTP map with Kraus operators sqrt(K(j|i)) times |j><i|, sending diagonal probabilities p to diagonal probabilities Kp.
imported_structure: complex square roots of nonnegative entries
K(j|i) nonnegative with each column summing to one
nodes.bottleneck: Summing A_ji adjoint times A_ji gives the identity by column normalization. The operator-sum formula is completely positive and its output on a diagonal state is diag(Kp). It erases off-diagonal entries. Thus it is one lift, not a unique coherence-preserving reconstruction of K. Independent proof review or Lean formalization is still required.

nodes.source_status: Editorial proof sketch awaiting independent replay; no new Lean build.

nodes.bottleneck: Inner-product preservation would give z=z squared, with z the overlap, for exact vector cloning. Allowing output phases still implies |z|=|z| squared. For 0<|z|<1 this is a contradiction. Orthogonal basis copying remains allowed. Independent proof review or Lean formalization is still required.
